# Venue noise regression: results (generated by venue_noise_regression.py; do not edit by hand)

Seed 42. Data: `venue_features` (5,704 real venues). Outcome: noise_complaints (NYC 311, 3 years). v1 = OLS on log(1 + complaints); test errors are in complaints.

## Split

| part | rows | mean complaints | median complaints |
|---|---|---|---|
| train | 3,992 | 3.28 | 0 |
| test | 1,712 | 3.30 | 0 |

## Fit

| measure | v1 |
|---|---|
| adjusted R², training fit (log scale) | 0.116 |
| R² train / test, log scale | 0.118 / 0.124 |
| R² train / test, complaints | -0.012 / -0.007 |
| raw-scale OLS adjusted R² (not used) | 0.030 |

## Baseline vs v1 on the test rows (complaints)

| metric | baseline (training mean) | v1 |
|---|---|---|
| R² | -0.000 | -0.007 |
| RMSE | 14.640 | 14.689 |
| MAE | 5.147 | 3.455 |

## Badge on the test rows (threshold 1 complaint(s))

| cell | meaning | baseline | v1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| TN | quiet, no badge | 0 | 988 |
| FP | quiet, badge | 1174 | 186 |
| FN | loud, no badge | 0 | 320 |
| TP | loud, badge | 538 | 218 |

The baseline badges every venue (training mean above the threshold), so its ranking is unchanged and it is valued as no badge.
